[MATH] Geography and Environment 5 Elements of environment : Environment is made of two kinds of elements - living and non living elements. Those who have life, take food, have intelligence, have birth/death and growth are living things/elements.Trees,birds and animals, insects, humans and other animals are living things. These are the living elements of environment. Earth, water, air, mountains, rivers, seas, light, temperature, moisture are the non living things/elements. They make non living environment. Task : Make inter-relationship among different elements of environment. Types of environment :There are two types of environment-natural environment and social environment. Earth, water, air, mountains, rivers, seas, light,trees, birds, animals and insects, constitute natural environment. On the other hand, human behaviours, rituals, education, values, economics and politics constitute social environment. Importance of studying geography and environment: Through reading Geography and Environment chapter, we can know- The nature and environment of a particular place of the earth. . Cause of formation and features of mountains, hills, rivers, oceans, plateaus, plains and deserts. Acquisition of scientific conceptions about the evolution of the animal world since the birth of the earth. About plants and animals and their variety in conducts, food habits and lifestyles. Changes made in social environment due to the development in agriculture, industry, trade and commerce, transportation and communication About cause of natural disaster casualties and control, geographical position, pattern of climate and importance of communication system. . Increase of temperature of the earth, greenhouse effect and its influence. Gaining economic solvency by man using natural resources. . Ocean and ocean resource management. Sample Questions
